# Vane

> Vane is a personalized weather app for iPhone that learns how different weather conditions feel to an individual and adds that personal context to a full weather forecast.

Vane's personalization system is called Sense. It learns from optional weather check-ins over time while Vane continues to provide standard forecast details such as temperature, precipitation, wind, humidity, UV, sunrise, and sunset. Vane is currently available as a free public iPhone beta through TestFlight.

## Product and beta

- [Vane home](https://vane.codearc.studio/): Official Vane website and product overview.
- [Vane Sense](https://vane.codearc.studio/sense/): How Vane's personalization system learns from optional weather check-ins and adds personal context to a forecast.
- [About Vane](https://vane.codearc.studio/about/): Why Vane exists, the principles behind the product, and information about CodeArc.studio.
- [Join the Vane beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/GHEW2GvN): Official TestFlight invitation for the free public iPhone beta.
